LinkedIn.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
LinkedIn.description: ABC Technologies is hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to build customer-facing web applications for our fintech platform. You will own features end to end across a React front end and Node.js services backed by PostgreSQL, deploy to AWS with Docker and CI/CD, and mentor two junior developers. We work hybrid from our Mumbai office three days a week.
requirements: 5+ years of professional software development experience
Strong experience with React and TypeScript
Strong experience with Node.js (Express or NestJS)
Experience with PostgreSQL and data modelling
Experience deploying to AWS with Docker
responsibilities: Design and build features across the stack
Review code and mentor junior developers
Improve performance and reliability of the platform

LinkedIn.title: Frontend Engineer (React)
LinkedIn.description: Northwind Labs builds analytics dashboards for logistics companies. We are looking for a Frontend Engineer who loves React, TypeScript and clean component design. You will work with a design system, GraphQL APIs and a fully remote team across India.
requirements: Experience consuming GraphQL or REST APIs
Good communication in a remote team

LinkedIn.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
LinkedIn.description: Lead the design of large-scale training pipelines and model serving infrastructure. Requires 10+ years of experience including deep expertise in PyTorch, distributed training, CUDA optimisation and a PhD in machine learning or related field.
requirements: PhD in ML or related field
